input.rationale: Fire damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets, ceiling, and walls from an accidental grease flare-up on their stove is clearly direct property damage to the home's structure and contents.

Damage includes charred cabinets and smoke damage across multiple surfaces in the kitchen. While localized to one room, cabinet replacement and smoke remediation on ceilings/walls typically range between $2,000–$25,000. No injuries mitigates severity.

input.claim_summary: Kitchen fire caused by grease flare-up on stove yesterday evening. Charred cabinets above stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries; fire was contained using extinguisher. Damage estimated in the $2,000–$25,000 range. Policy POL-1001 is active with $500 deductible and adequate coverage.
